summary.ru: Бантам — мусульманское государство. Располагалось в западной части острова Ява, и образовалось после распада империи Маджапахит.
summary.en: The Banten Sultanate was a Bantenese Islamic trading kingdom founded in the 16th century and centred in Banten, a port city on the northwest coast of Java; the contemporary English name of both was Bantam. It is said to have been founded by Sunan Gunungjati, who had previously founded Cirebon.
